title: Iran to ration electricity as war hits energy network

blocks.text: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran will impose rolling power cuts starting Sunday as damage to key infrastructure during the Middle East war deepens an already severe energy crunch, state media reported. “Given the country’s fuel supply conditions, the electricity sector will be forced to impose distribution restrictions from Sunday,” Mohammad Allahdad, head of Iran’s national electricity company, told state TV on Saturday. The outages are expected to last around two hours every two days, or up to two hours a day, depending on the area, he said. Iran has introduced similar measures in recent years because of fuel shortages at power plants. […]... Keep on reading: Iran to ration electricity as war hits energy network
